prompt: Which unit is **best** for measuring the mass of an apple?
hint: Mass means how much matter — which units measure mass?

hints.text: Mass means how much matter — which units measure mass?
Kilometers measure distance, liters measure liquid, hours measure time.
Grams measure mass — an apple is about $150$–$250$ g. Choose B.

explanation: Mass is measured in grams or kilograms.
An apple has a small mass, so grams fit best (about $200$ g).
